title: Private player self-report
description: Player perceptions after the conversation, never a ground-truth score or input to the tested agent.

goalReached.description: I believe an acceptable resolution occurred. This does not establish backend success.

understoodStatus.description: I understand what happened, what remains undone, and the next step.

misled.description: I feel the agent misled me. This is not proof of dishonesty.

frustration.description: 1 means not frustrated, 3 means noticeably frustrated, and 5 means ready to abandon the interaction.

why.description: One sentence explaining my perceived outcome and status.
